sn48.49:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
sn48.49:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā piṇḍolabhāradvājena aññā byākatā hoti
sn48.49:1.4: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti.
sn48.49:1.5: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn48.49:2.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti.
sn48.49:2.3: kiṃ nu kho bhante atthavasaṃ sampassamānena āyasmatā piṇḍolabhāradvājena aññā byākatā
sn48.49:2.4: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti.
sn48.49:3.1: tiṇṇaṃ kho bhikkhave indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā piṇḍolabhāradvājena bhikkhunā aññā byākatā
sn48.49:3.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti.
sn48.49:3.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ indriyānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā piṇḍolabhāradvājena bhikkhunā aññā byākatā
sn48.49:3.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti.
sn48.49:3.7: imāni ca bhikkhave tīṇi indriyāni kimantāni.
sn48.49:3.11: jātijarāmaraṇakkhayanti kho bhikkhave sampassamānena piṇḍolabhāradvājena bhikkhunā aññā byākatā
sn48.49:3.12: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmīti.
